name: printing-press-amend
conclusion: printing-press-amend (Escalate) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 5 autonomy limits, 6 clarification rules, 6 approval gates, 6 validation rules, 7 escalation rules. Strongest: escalation rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 5 autonomy limits (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: allowed tools; absolute binary path for every invocation; sniffing only when the user named it.

statements.quote: allowed-tools:
Every subsequent `cli-printing-press ...` invocation in this skill must use that absolute path**
Sniff is opt-in per run — never invoked unless the user named it.
This phase runs unattended between checkpoints 1 and 2.
All edits in this phase happen INSIDE `$CLI_DIR`. Never touch `$PRESS_LIBRARY/<slug>/` — that's a different working copy and editing it would not flow to the PR.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 6 clarification rules (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly list: ambiguous input mode; resolved session transcript path; auto-detected target CLI.

statements.quote: Ask the user via `AskUserQuestion`:
ALWAYS confirm the resolved path with the user via `AskUserQuestion` before reading — wrong-file selection ingests friction from the wrong session.
Confirm with `AskUserQuestion` (single CLI: simple yes/no; multiple close: pick from list).
if absent, ask the user.
Ambiguous verbs (`update X` without specifics) trigger an `AskUserQuestion` clarification rather than a guess.
If neither field is set, ask the user inline:

approval_gates.conclusion: 6 approval gates (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose: upgrading a below-floor binary; custom-selected finding subset; re-adding deferred findings.

statements.quote: Offer a one-click upgrade via `AskUserQuestion` — **Yes — upgrade now** (run `go install github.com/mvanhorn/cli-printing-press/v4/cmd/cli-printing-press@latest`, re-capture `PRINTING_PRESS_BIN`, then
For the **custom selection** path: present a multi-select with each finding's id + category + one-line rationale; confirm the user-checked subset before proceeding.
do not silently re-add — always present and confirm.
Show the user EVERYTHING that's about to ship before any `gh` command fires.
AskUserQuestion: open / edit / hold / abort
For **edit then open**: present the title and body as separate editable blocks, accept the user's revisions, re-display the full draft, confirm before proceeding.

validation.conclusion: 6 validation rules (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 3 conditional), mostly prose: consolidated publish validator after edits; re-running validate after failures; missing or empty patch manifest.

statements.quote: After all edits land, run the consolidated validator (replace `<PRINTING_PRESS_BIN>` with the absolute path captured at setup):
If `publish validate` reports failures, parse the error categories from the JSON, attempt targeted fixes, re-run validate.
Missing or empty patch manifest → fix locally before continuing.
Before Phase 4 can emit a pass, inspect the confirmed findings and final diff for every new, renamed, or changed user-facing command, flag, workflow, runtime mode, or MCP-visible action.

Run `python3 .github/scripts/verify-skill/verify_skill.py --dir "$CLI_DIR"` from the public-library checkout when that path exists; otherwise run the packaged verifier equivalent available in the chec
Do not move to the PR-draft checkpoint until the checklist is empty.

escalation.conclusion: 7 escalation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 6 conditional), mostly prose: setup advisories such as low disk; binary older than the minimum version; failed upgrade command.

statements.quote: If setup emitted `[go-toolchain-old]` or `[low-disk]`, surface the advisory to the user and continue unless setup also emitted `[setup-error]`.

If the installed binary is older than the minimum, stop immediately and tell the user: "cli-printing-press binary vX.Y.Z is older than the minimum required vA.B.C. Run `go install github.com/mvanhorn/
If the upgrade command fails, surface it and stop.
If `local_ver` is older than `published` (semver comparison), abort cleanly:
Surface the final error log to the user, do NOT auto-open the PR, exit.
If any required doc edit or verifier result is missing, stop with a blocking checklist.
If any match is found, treat as BLOCKING — pause and require user resolution before Phase 6.
